results.name: Wildfire in Latakia, Syria
results.reason: On the 3 July 2025, a wildfire is reported to have affected Latakia region, Syria. The event occurred in the coastal mountain of Latakia region. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide reference, initial rough estimation, wildfire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
